text.en:
Creation of the National Engineering Center. There is hereby created and established the
National Engineering Center (hereafter referred to as NEC in the University of the Philippines System). The
NEC shall be a distinct and separate unit from the UP College of Engineering and shall absorb the UP
Industrial Research Service Center, the National Hydraulic Research Center, the Training Center for Applied
Geodesy and Photogrammetry, the Transport Training Center, and the Building Research Service. Purely
academic functions shall be undertaken by the UP College of Engineering at a larger scale to be made possible
by the financial support of the NEC.

Objectives. The NEC shall have the following objectives:
(a) To provide a pool of technical experts to which public and private entities may turn for assistance in the
solution of engineering problems.
(b) To develop technologies that utilize local resources which are adapted to the needs of a developing

Executive Director of the NEC. The NEC shall be headed by an Executive Director who shall be
appointed by the Board of Regents of the University of the Philippines System upon recommendation of the
President of the University. He shall be under the immediate administrative supervision of the President of the
University.

Advisory Board. The plans and programs of the NEC shall be reviewed and approved by an
Advisory Board composed of:
(a)The Executive Vice-President of the University of the Philippines SystemChairman
(b)Dean, UP College of EngineeringMember
(c)The Undersecretary of Public Works, Transportation & CommunicationMember
(d)The Undersecretary of IndustryMember
(e)The president of the UP Alumni EngineerMember
(f)(2) members to be appointed by the Board of Regents of the University of the Philippines System upon the
recommendation of the Member
Dean of the UP College of Engineering who shall serve for a term of three (3) years and may be reappointed
for another term of three (3) years.

Service of Scientists and Technical Personnel. The NEC may, for the purpose of its research and
development activities, obtain the services of scientists and technical personnel of other units in the University
of the Philippines System and of any other agency of the government of the Republic of the Philippines. Such
personnel may be paid additional compensation or honoraria by the NEC. Any government retiree employed
in the Center shall not be required to reimburse or refund any gratuity or pension received from the
government nor shall any pension or annuity be suspended or reduced on account of his employment in the

Building Construction and Equipment Purchase. The NEC is hereby authorized to construct
buildings and other facilities and to purchase equipment locally and abroad as may be necessary to carry out
its functions.

Operating Revenues. The NEC is authorized to charge fees for consultancy and other services
rendered, to utilize the proceeds of such fees in the conduct of the work contracted for, and to retain any
surplus in a Special Account in the General Fund for use in the improvement of the operations of the NEC,
including the purchase of laboratory equipment and building expansion: Provided, That, consultancy services
for government agencies and corporations shall be subject to pertinent law and regulations, particularly the
level of consultancy rates: Provided, Further, That the cost of personnel services, honoraria, and staff
contractual fees paid from operating revenues to officials and employees of the University of the Philippines
shall observe standard policy, procedure and rates as may be approved by the NEC.

Position Classification and Compensation. The position classification and compensation rates
paid to the staff members of the NEC shall be the same as those applicable to the University of the Philippines
System: Provided, That, honoraria and consultancy rates shall be within the limits established under the
annual General Appropriations Law.

Special Auditing Rules and Regulations. Expenditures and disbursements made by the NEC in
the conduct of its activities shall be subject to special auditing and accounting rules and regulations suited to
the requirements of research. These special auditing rules and regulations shall be formulated by the Office of
the President of the University of the Philippines System and the Commission on Audit and submitted to the
President of the Republic of the Philippines for review and approval within four (4) months after approval of

this Decree.

The transitory Provisions. All existing Centers in the UP College of Engineering shall become
part of the NEC. Government budget allocations to the said existing Centers shall be transferred to the NEC
except budgetary allotments for purely instructional purposes.
All equipment of the said existing Centers in the UP College of Engineering used for purely instructional
purposes shall be retained by the College. However, arrangements shall be made to share equipment used for
instructional and research purposes between the College and the NEC.

Separability Clause. If any provision of this Decree or the application thereof to any person or
circumstance is declared unconstitutional or invalid for any reason, the same shall not effect the validity of the
other provisions.

Repealing Clause. All acts, parts of acts, executive orders, ordinances, rules and regulations
which are inconsistent with the provisions of this Presidential Decree are hereby repealed, amended or
modified accordingly.

Effectivity. This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 27th day of January, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
